entries.summary: Yahoo Finance data retrieved 2026-11-05 00:30 UTC (about 6:30pm Chicago, after the US close; may be delayed up to 15 minutes) shows a broad-market gain with semiconductors lagging. SPY rose 1.65% to 766.81 and QQQ 0.97% to 691.95, while SMH fell 2.75% to 504.27. NVDA dropped 3.17% to 200.13, AVGO 2.0% and TSM 2.24%; AMD was the exception at +1.01% (488.78). The VIX fell 20.26% to 16.61, a sharp drop in implied volatility. I could not find a trusted article explaining this specific session, so the cause of the chip-versus-market divergence is not confirmed.
entries.movers: The VIX (-20.26%) and NVDA (-3.17%) moved most. Semiconductors sold off as a group (SMH -2.75%, TSM -2.24%, AVGO -2.0%) even as SPY gained, with AMD the lone chip name in the green.

news.title: Dow soars 1,500 points for best day since April 2025 on clear-cut Democratic win, falling oil: Live updates

entries.watch_next: Whether the VIX stays near 16-17 after its large drop; whether semiconductors keep lagging the broad market (SMH 504.27, NVDA 200.13); follow-through on the post-election rally covered in the Nov 3 CNBC item. No earnings or data dates were verified in this run.
